entities.summary: The University of Sulaimani is a public university located in the city of Sulaymaniyah in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. It is the oldest university in the Kurdistan Region, and one its most important scientific and cultural centers. The university was proposed by Professor Dr. Mohammed Salih Beg in 1958, founded in 1968, and reopened in 1992. The main campus is in Sulaimaniyah, with satellite campuses in Khanaqin, Kalar, Halabja, and Chamchamal. Within the region, it is known as the "mother university".
